spans.s:
r. 1st. cl. (फुल्लति)
To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
1 Blown, opened, expanded as a flower.
2 Opened (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay.
E.
फुल्ल to blow, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.

n. (-म)
A species of the Atidhṛti metre.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Full or large-eyed.
2 Smiling, looking happy.
E.
फुल्ल, and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र, फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.

m. (-लः)
Winnowing corn.
E.
फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Full-eyed.
2 Looking pleased or happy.
n. (-नं)
A large full eye.
m. (-नः)
A species of the antelope.
E.
फुल्ल full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Blossoming, blowing.
E.
फुल्ल to blow, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Looking pleased or happy.
E.
फुल्ल, and वदन the face.

f. (-ल्लिः)
Blowing, blossoming.
E.
फुल्ल to blow, aff. इन्.

f. (तिः)
Flowering, blossoming.
E.
फुल्ल to blow, क्तिन् aff.
